facts.statement: Humans, elves, and dragons coexist in the Valley of Dragons and exchange knowledge and skills.
Dragons are described as the first of the three peoples to inhabit the valley.
Elves arrived after dragons and before humans.
Human river cities process raw resources from highlands and exchange manufactured goods for food from outer agricultural regions.
Elven plantsmithing shapes living plants into useful forms such as furniture and shelters.
The Dragon Rider Knights defend the valley using dragons, weapons, and magic.
The order is led by three paladins at a time.
Alaric becomes the first human Dragon Rider Knight.
A dragon and rider form a deep personal bond extending beyond a purely military partnership.
The Dark God's origin is not known to the valley's people.
Old elven songs contain warnings or references associated with the Dark God.
The Sword of the Dawn enables Alaric to destroy the Dark God.
Kordran is considered the more appropriate deity for Alaric's martial mission than Valerion.
